hypothesis: Current native D radix reuse can reduce actual sender transfer indices when the same independent prefix returns to the same logical D DP; P cached_tokens is not D proof.
controls: Novel prefix text nonce prevents old D cache hit
4 unique full suffixes/family, tokenizer roundtrip and unique first tail boundary
Native returned dp_rank and D decode moments must show target execution
Per-request native P sender metric deltas retained per rank; do not sum replicated rank reports or label physical HCCS bytes
All raw SSE, metadata, before/after loads and metrics preserved
No inference comparing this C1 diagnostic to AIS C64 throughput

outcomes.supported: Repeated D destinations show lower sender transfer bytes/indices while actual 80K600 input/output token, cache and route gates pass; source describes prefix delta. This is not an independent model-quality equivalence test.
outcomes.falsified_or_unavailable: No byte reduction, missing/contaminated counters, or invalid prefix ownership retained as negative/inconclusive; do not force success or launch a large matrix.
outcomes.on_failure: Abort only this task RIDs, drain, preserve raw; no automatic replay/restart.

execution: Exact launcher once through local ZCode configured DeepSeek; no timers or subagents.
